Drummer Jackie Williams keeps company with some of the greatest artists in jazz. A native New Yorker, he grew up in the fertile jazz atmosphere of the City, also absorbing the dance grooves of rhythm & blues. He is a first call drummer for jazz recordings and appears with Dizzy Gillespie on Milt Hinton’s “Old Man Time.”
Jackie was interviewed in New York City on October 18, 1995 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive, in New York City, with drummer Jackie Williams, and it’s a great pleasure to be here with you. Can I call you an “in demand” drummer in New York?
Oh, that sounds good, I like that.
I think you are. It took me a few times to reach you so you must be out there.
I’m out there trying to do something, yeah.
